features.name: Hunter's Intuition
features.description: Whenever you make a Wisdom (Perception) or a Wisdom (Survival) check, you can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the total ability check.

features.name: Enhanced Senses
features.description: You have proficiency in the Perception skill.

features.name: Finder's Magic
features.description: You know the True Strike cantrip. Starting at 3rd level, you can cast Hunter's Mark with this trait. Starting at 5th level, you can also cast Locate Object with this trait. Once you cast Hunter's Mark or Locate Object with this trait, you can’t cast that spell with it again until you finish a long rest. You can also cast either spell using any spell slots you have of the appropriate level. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is your spellcasting ability for these spells when you cast them with this trait (choose when you select this race). Additionally, if you have the Spellcasting or Pact Magic feature, the following spells are added to the spell list of that class. Spell Level Spell 1st Faerie Fire, Longstrider 2nd Locate Animals or Plants, Locate Object 3rd Clairvoyance, Speak With Plants 4th Divination, Locate Creature 5th Commune With Nature
